name: jellyfin-plugin-iina
description: A Jellyfin server plugin that opens videos directly in IINA.

scripts.build:plugin: npm run build:client && mise exec -- dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina/Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina.csproj --configuration Release --output artifacts/plugin
scripts.build:plugin:legacy: npm run build:client && mise exec -- dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina/Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina.csproj --configuration Release --output artifacts/plugin-10.7.7 -p:LegacyBuild=true
scripts.check: npm run build:client && node --test && mise exec -- dotnet test Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina.Tests/Jellyfin.Plugin.Iina.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --warnaserror
